comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten a pin-index oxygen regulator onto a cylinder valve; candidate separates finishing media from workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Hidden-pin alignment, yoke insertion, sealing-face seating and repeated T-screw regrasping versus bimanual screen lifting, agitation, retention and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Both pins inserted, washer seated square, ≥0.75 N·m clamp torque, released stillness and no drop versus ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, screen supported and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: The record tests keyed precision assembly and torque-controlled sealing, not selective many-body separation; all necessary novelty rubric details are present.
